product_one_liner.value: Bizagi enables enterprise business and IT teams to build low-code applications and automate end-to-end business processes, orchestrating people, systems, data, AI and bots.

pricing_page.notes: Public page describes consumption-based pricing; it does not publish numerical prices.

eng_blog.notes: The located technical articles are attributed to an editor or product marketing director, not engineers; the two engineer-authored, product-build posts criterion was not met.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The listed AI-First Full Stack Developer (.NET / Angular / Azure) role has AI in its title and requires experience using LLMs throughout software development; it is not a data-science research role. The job-board snapshot is dated 2026-11-08.

model_provider.value: OpenAI models through Microsoft Azure AI / Azure OpenAI Service

compliance_certs.notes: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 is explicitly certified. HIPAA and GDPR are compliance claims, not separately described certifications. SOC 2 and PCI DSS references concern the Azure infrastructure rather than Bizagi certification.

raised_18mo.notes: Latest recorded funding is September 2017, before the 2025-05-09–2026-11-09 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: No qualifying title was visible in the current job-board material checked (snapshot dated 2026-11-08). The located BDR and account-executive postings are explicitly marked removed.

launched_6mo.notes: Summer 2026 was released on 2026-07-21, within the 2026-05-09–2026-11-09 window, introducing Kafka event streaming and other major capabilities.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The leadership roster is public but undated; checked announcements and profiles did not establish a C-level or VP join or departure during 2025-11-09–2026-11-09.

crm_stack_signal.notes: CRM and marketing job descriptions explicitly identify Dynamics CRM and Marketo as Bizagi systems; the BDR description names LinkedIn Sales Navigator and Outreach for prospecting and pipeline activity. These are stack signals from job descriptions, including historical postings, not proof of current contracts.
